headline: Officials discussed how to fund street paving after the 10-year bond plan ends in 2028, including a possible $1 million-a-year motor vehicle fee.
summary: City staff presented the paving program's history, completed work, and street selection process. The 10-year bond plan for street work ends in 2028, and rising debt payments may exceed current road funding. Staff listed options, including a motor vehicle fee of up to $5 per registration that could raise about $1 million a year.
